findings.summary: The revoke operation (b3) now runs before the user confirms or cancels in BlockConfirmDialog (b6), so cancelling happens after sharing has already been revoked and the Block recorded.
findings.evidence: b2 next: b3; b3 'Participant authority checked; sharing revoked; pending deliveries cancelled; Block recorded' next: b6; b6 'Confirm block or cancel' -> e2 when cancel

findings.summary: The cancel path ends at e2 'No block recorded' even though b3 has already recorded the Block. This contradicts the affordance effect and the new criterion claim.
findings.evidence: affordance effect: 'Nothing is revoked or recorded until the owner confirms in BlockConfirmDialog'; criterion: 'Cancelling a block confirmation leaves sharing and pending jobs untouched'; e2: 'No block recorded'
